title: Joined the Thespians
text: Over six years in the troupe I worked as photographer, documentarian, production assistant and treasurer, then served as president.

title: Started at OCSA
text: Four years at the Orange County School of the Arts, where most of what follows happened.

title: Priceless Pets
text: Three years volunteering at the shelter and helping adopters find the right animal.

title: Built sets, mentored kids
text: As a student leader at OCCAF I built sets from the ground up and mentored young people, including children with special needs.

title: Took the director's chair
text: Directed Art Attack Live, OCSA's live broadcast, after working teleprompter, playback, camera, graphics and technical direction.

title: Joined the yearbook
text: Editorial board at Dreamscape and senior editor at Digital Yearbook, teaching 30+ students to run cameras and conduct interviews.

title: Live, multi-camera
text: Graphic engineer at Calvary Chapel Chino Hills, switching cameras and running graphics during live broadcasts.

title: Started in marketing
text: Marketing analyst at WorldWideSnacks, studying social trends and when audiences actually show up.

title: The Gala
text: Technical director, playback and graphics for the OCSA Gala broadcast, which helped raise more than $1.2 million.

title: Director's Choice
text: Director's Choice at FTV 2026, and a Dreamscape Yearbook recognized as 1 of 2 in California.

title: Finished at OCSA, went to camp
text: Finished at OCSA in June, then spent the summer at SoCal Yearbook Camp teaching social media to 30+ students and growing engagement 6,120%.

title: Perng Production
text: Making films and shooting senior portraits.
